about_zh: 把东西跑起来、跑稳：容器、部署、CI、监控。

repos.description: A list of SaaS, PaaS and IaaS offerings that have free tiers of interest to devops and infradev
repos.summary_zh: free-for.dev 是一个面向开发者和运维人员的精选免费服务清单，涵盖 SaaS、PaaS、IaaS 等基础设施类工具。该列表聚焦于 DevOps 和系统管理员常用服务，强调长期可用的免费层级（非试用），并排除自托管软件。内容由社区协作维护，包含云管理、CI/CD、监控、安全等 30+ 个分类，帮助开发者快速发现并评估适合的免费资源。
repos.summary_en: free-for.dev is a curated list of free-tier SaaS, PaaS, and IaaS services tailored for developers and infrastructure teams. It focuses on tools useful for DevOps, sysadmins, and cloud engineers, excluding self-hosted software and limited-time trials. Maintained by a community of 1600+ contributors, it covers 30+ categories including cloud management, CI/CD, monitoring, security, and more, enabling informed decisions about free developer offerings.

repos.description: ⭐AI-driven public opinion & trend monitor with multi-platform aggregation, RSS, and smart alerts.🎯 告别信息过载，你的 AI 舆情监控助手与热点筛选工具！聚合多平台热点 +  RSS 订阅，支持关键词精准筛选。AI 智能筛选新闻 + AI 翻译 +  AI 分析简报直推手机，也支持接入 MCP 架构，赋能 AI 自然语言对话分析、情感洞察与趋势预测等。支持 Docker ，数据本地/云端自持。集成微信/飞书/钉钉/Telegram/邮件/ntfy/bark/slack 等渠道智能推送。
repos.summary_zh: TrendRadar 是一款 AI 驱动的舆情监控工具，支持多平台热点聚合、RSS 订阅与智能关键词筛选，提供 AI 翻译与分析简报推送。集成微信/飞书/钉钉等 8+ 通知渠道，支持 Docker 部署与 MCP 架构，赋能 AI 对话分析、情感洞察与趋势预测，30 秒快速部署。
repos.summary_en: TrendRadar is an AI-powered public opinion and trend monitoring tool that aggregates multi-platform hot topics, RSS feeds, and offers smart keyword filtering. It delivers AI-translated analysis briefs via 8+ notification channels (WeChat, Feishu, DingTalk, etc.), supports Docker deployment and MCP architecture for AI-driven sentiment analysis and trend forecasting, with a 30-second setup.

repos.description: Developer-first error tracking and performance monitoring
repos.summary_zh: Sentry 是一款开发者优先的错误追踪与性能监控平台，提供实时问题检测、错误追踪、性能分析和用户行为回放功能，支持 20+ 编程语言和框架的官方 SDK，助力团队快速定位并修复代码缺陷。
repos.summary_en: Sentry is a developer-first error tracking and performance monitoring platform that enables real-time issue detection, error tracing, performance insights, and user session replay. It supports 20+ languages via official SDKs, helping teams debug and resolve problems faster.

repos.description: Delegate anything. It comes back done.
repos.summary_zh: Minds 是一款面向知识工作者的通用 AI 平台，支持在云、VPC、本地及隔离环境中灵活部署，让用户完全掌控基础设施、模型、权限与数据。它帮助创作者、策略师和运营人员自动化复杂的多步骤读写任务，并无需工程背景即可构建和部署内部 AI 工具（如应用、报告、分析等），实现真正可控的 AI 协作体验。
repos.summary_en: Minds is a general-purpose AI platform designed for knowledge workers—creators, strategists, and operators—offering full control over AI systems with flexible deployment across cloud, VPC, on-prem, and air-gapped environments. It enables users to automate complex multi-step read/write tasks and build, deploy internal AI tools (apps, reports, analyses) without engineering expertise, ensuring complete infrastructure, model, permission, and data control.

repos.description: Open Source Alternative to Vercel, Netlify and Heroku.
repos.summary_zh: Dokploy 是一款开源、可自托管的 PaaS 平台，旨在替代 Vercel、Netlify 和 Heroku。它极大简化了应用与数据库的部署管理，原生支持 Docker Compose 与多节点 Swarm 集群，集成 Traefik 实现自动路由，并提供实时监控、多服务器管理及丰富的通知功能。
repos.summary_en: Dokploy is an open-source, self-hostable PaaS platform designed as an alternative to Vercel, Netlify, and Heroku. It simplifies application and database deployment with native Docker Compose support, multi-node Swarm clustering, integrated Traefik routing, real-time monitoring, and comprehensive multi-server management.

repos.description: CAT 作为服务端项目基础组件，提供了 Java, C/C++, Node.js, Python, Go 等多语言客户端，已经在美团点评的基础架构中间件框架（MVC框架，RPC框架，数据库框架，缓存框架等，消息队列，配置系统等）深度集成，为美团点评各业务线提供系统丰富的性能指标、健康状况、实时告警等。
repos.summary_zh: CAT 是美团点评开源的实时应用监控平台，支持 Java、C/C++、Node.js、Python、Go 等多语言客户端，提供 Transaction、Event、Heartbeat、Metric 四种监控模型。其核心优势在于秒级实时数据处理、全量数据采集、高可用部署及高吞吐扩展能力，广泛应用于服务端性能监控、故障定位与业务优化。
repos.summary_en: CAT is a real-time application monitoring platform developed by Meituan-Dianping, offering multi-language clients (Java, C/C++, Node.js, Python, Go) and supporting four monitoring models: Transaction, Event, Heartbeat, and Metric. It excels in sub-minute real-time processing, full-data collection, high availability, and scalable distributed deployment, enabling comprehensive performance tracking, fault detection, and system optimization across enterprise infrastructure.

repos.description: Self-hosted deployment platform
repos.summary_zh: Openship 是一款开源、可自托管的部署平台，内置 CI/CD 功能。它支持通过桌面应用、Web 面板或 CLI 推送代码、部署容器及管理基础设施，实现零配置文件的“一键式”应用交付。
repos.summary_en: Openship is an open-source, self-hostable deployment platform with built-in CI/CD. It enables push-to-deploy workflows, container management, and infrastructure control via desktop app, web dashboard, or CLI, requiring zero configuration files.

repos.description: CloudFlare free temp domain email 免费收发 临时域名邮箱 支持附件 IMAP SMTP TelegramBot
repos.summary_zh: 基于 Cloudflare Workers 构建的免费临时邮箱服务，支持收发邮件、附件处理、IMAP/SMTP 协议及 Telegram 机器人通知，采用 Rust WASM 实现高性能邮件解析，提供现代化多语言响应式界面，支持邮箱地址密码保护，完全免费且无需服务器部署。
repos.summary_en: A fully-featured free temporary email service built on Cloudflare Workers, supporting email sending/receiving, attachments, IMAP/SMTP protocols, and Telegram bot notifications. Uses Rust WASM for high-performance email parsing, offers a modern responsive UI with multi-language support, and enables password protection for email addresses—all at zero cost with no server required.

repos.description: Bytebot is a self-hosted AI desktop agent that automates computer tasks through natural language commands, operating within a containerized Linux desktop environment.
repos.summary_zh: Bytebot 是一个自托管的开源 AI 桌面代理，通过自然语言指令自动化计算机任务。它运行在容器化的 Linux 桌面环境中，拥有完整的虚拟桌面，可自主使用各类应用程序、处理文件、登录网站、读取文档并执行复杂的多步骤工作流程，真正实现 AI 拥有独立计算机的自主操作能力。
repos.summary_en: Bytebot is an open-source, self-hosted AI desktop agent that automates computer tasks via natural language commands. Operating within a containerized Linux desktop environment, it provides a full virtual desktop where it can use any application, manage files, authenticate on websites, process documents, and execute complex multi-step workflows with complete autonomy.

repos.description: Give your agent a computer 👾
repos.summary_zh: Cloudflare Computer 是基于 Durable Objects 的虚拟文件系统，以 SQLite 为权威状态存储，提供可插拔执行后端。支持容器化 Linux、just-bash Shell 和 ECMAScript 模块三种运行模式，为 AI 智能体、自动化任务和代码沙箱提供统一执行入口。
repos.summary_en: Cloudflare Computer is a virtual filesystem built on Durable Objects with SQLite state management and pluggable execution backends. It supports three modes: containerized Linux, just-bash shell in Dynamic Workers, and ECMAScript modules. Provides a unified execution entry point for AI agents, automation tasks, and code sandboxing on the Cloudflare Workers platform.

repos.description: 一个自己找热点、自己写日报的网站框架。把信源和精选标准换成你的，它就是你的行业热点站。
repos.summary_zh: AIHOT 是一个开源的行业热点监测框架，自动从多源采集资讯，经大模型预筛、双评分与去重聚簇，生成中文标题、摘要与日报/周报/月报，支持 RSS、X、微信公众号等信源，可快速部署为法律、金融、HR 等垂直领域的智能热点站。
repos.summary_en: AIHOT is an open-source framework for industry-specific news aggregation. It auto-collects from RSS, web, X and WeChat, applies AI pre-filtering, dual scoring and event clustering, then generates Chinese headlines, summaries and daily/weekly/monthly reports. Deployable as a vertical hotspot dashboard for legal, financial, HR domains.

repos.description: A very powerful and friendly  nginx base on lua-nginx-module( openresty ) which provide WAF, Control Panel, and Dashboards.
repos.summary_zh: VeryNginx 是基于 OpenResty 的强大 Nginx 增强工具，集成 WAF、访问统计、控制面板和仪表盘，支持自定义匹配器与动作实现灵活规则引擎，提供友好的 Web 界面管理复杂流量策略。
repos.summary_en: VeryNginx is a powerful and user-friendly Nginx extension based on OpenResty, featuring built-in WAF, real-time access statistics, control panel, and dashboards. It enables advanced traffic management through customizable matchers and actions, offering a web interface for complex rule-based request processing and security enforcement.

repos.description: ezBookkeeping is an open source, powerful, self-hosted personal finance app that is easy to use.
repos.summary_zh: ezBookkeeping 是一款轻量级自托管个人财务管理应用，支持 Docker 快速部署，具备用户友好的界面和强大的记账功能。支持多语言、多币种、AI 收据识别、数据导入导出（CSV/OFX/QFX 等），并提供图表分析、地理位置标记、双因素认证等高级特性，适用于 Raspberry Pi、NAS 等低资源设备。
repos.summary_en: ezBookkeeping is a lightweight, self-hosted personal finance app with a user-friendly interface and powerful bookkeeping features. It supports Docker deployment, multi-language/currency, AI receipt recognition, data import/export (CSV/OFX/QFX), chart analytics, location tagging, and 2FA, optimized for low-resource devices like Raspberry Pi and NAS.

repos.description: Intelligent adaptive brightness for your external monitors
repos.summary_zh: Lunar 是一款专为 macOS 设计的显示器控制应用，支持通过 DDC/CI 协议直接调节外接显示器亮度、音量、输入源及屏幕方向。其核心亮点包括传感器/同步/位置自适应亮度调节、XDR/HDR 高亮度支持、低于 0% 的暗光模式、App 预设配置及 BlackOut 功能（关闭屏幕同时保留充电、音频等功能），完美兼容 Intel 与 Apple Silicon 芯片。
repos.summary_en: Lunar is a macOS app for controlling external monitors via DDC/CI, enabling hardware-level brightness, volume, input switching, and orientation adjustments. Key features include sensor/sync/location-based adaptive brightness, support for 1000–1600 nits XDR/HDR displays, sub-zero dimming, app-specific presets, and BlackOut mode—preserving charging, audio, and input while turning off screens. Fully compatible with both Intel and Apple Silicon Macs.

repos.description: Self-hosted webscraper.
repos.summary_zh: Scraperr 是一款强大的自托管网页爬虫解决方案，支持无代码配置、XPath精准提取、多任务队列管理、媒体下载及结果可视化导出，适用于数据采集与自动化分析场景。
repos.summary_en: Scraperr is a powerful self-hosted web scraping tool enabling code-free configuration, XPath-based extraction, queue management, media downloads, and structured data export, ideal for automated data collection and analysis.

repos.description: A cute temporary email service built with NextJS + Cloudflare technology stack 🎉 | 一个基于 NextJS + Cloudflare 技术栈构建的可爱临时邮箱服务🎉
repos.summary_zh: MoeMail 是一个基于 Next.js 和 Cloudflare 技术栈构建的可爱临时邮箱服务，提供隐私保护、实时邮件接收、灵活有效期设置、主题切换、PWA 支持等功能，支持自建部署、邮件发送、Webhook 通知及 OpenAPI 访问，界面简洁友好，适合个人或团队使用。
repos.summary_en: MoeMail is a cute temporary email service built with Next.js and Cloudflare, offering privacy protection, real-time email receipt, flexible validity periods, theme switching, PWA support, and self-hosting capabilities. It supports email sending, webhook notifications, OpenAPI access, and a user-friendly interface for personal or team use.

repos.description: 一个基于 Cloudflare Workers + D1 + Durable Objects 的免费多服务器监控探针系统，支持实时监控、离线告警，到期通知，历史数据查看、延迟追踪、地图展示等功能。兼容主流Linux系统，Alpine Linux，OpenWrt，macOS，群晖 DSM、飞牛 fnOS、Windows系统。
repos.summary_zh: CF-Server-Monitor 是一款基于 Cloudflare Workers + D1 的多服务器监控探针系统，支持实时追踪 CPU、内存、磁盘、网络等指标，提供历史图表、全球地图展示、离线告警及 WebSocket 实时推送。兼容 Linux、Alpine、OpenWrt 和 Windows 系统，集成 JWT 认证与 Turnstile 人机验证，通过 GitHub Actions 实现一键部署，适合运维自动化与多节点监控场景。
repos.summary_en: CF-Server-Monitor is a multi-server monitoring probe system built on Cloudflare Workers and D1, offering real-time tracking of CPU, memory, disk, and network metrics with historical charts, global map visualization, offline alerts, and WebSocket-based live updates. Compatible with Linux, Alpine, OpenWrt, and Windows, it integrates JWT authentication and Turnflare Turnstile verification, enabling one-click deployment via GitHub Actions for efficient operations automation and multi-node monitoring.

repos.description: Check酱：监测网页内容变化，并发送异动到微信。亦支持http status、json和rss监测。配合自架云端，关电脑后也能运行。
repos.summary_zh: Check酱是一款网页内容监控工具，支持通过浏览器插件监测网页内容变化，并将异动推送至微信等消息通道。支持HTTP状态、JSON和RSS监测，配合自建云端服务可实现24小时运行。具备可视化选择器、周期任务调度及多平台部署能力。
repos.summary_en: Check酱 is a web content monitoring tool that detects changes on web pages via a browser plugin and sends alerts to WeChat or other channels. It supports HTTP status, JSON, and RSS monitoring, with optional cloud deployment for continuous operation. Features include visual selector, scheduled tasks, and multi-platform support.

repos.description: 一个基于 NextJS + Cloudflare 技术栈构建的可爱消息推送服务, 支持多种消息推送渠道✨
repos.summary_zh: MoePush 是基于 Next.js 和 Cloudflare 构建的开源消息推送服务，支持钉钉、企业微信、Telegram 等 8 种推送渠道，提供简洁的 API 接口与精美 UI，采用 Drizzle ORM 和 D1 数据库，支持 GitHub 登录与 Docker 部署，适合快速集成多平台消息通知。
repos.summary_en: MoePush is an open-source message push service built with Next.js and Cloudflare, supporting 8+ channels including DingTalk, WeCom, and Telegram. It offers a clean API, shadcn/ui-based UI, GitHub OAuth, D1 database via Drizzle ORM, and Docker deployment for easy multi-platform notification integration.

repos.description: 完全运行于 Cloudflare Worker的现代聊天系统：实时通信、Telegram 双向桥接、消息与文件加密 A modern, self-hosted team chat built on Cloudflare — realtime messaging, Telegram bridge, encrypted messages & files, and WebMCP. |
repos.summary_zh: EdgeChat 是基于 Cloudflare 全家桶构建的零运维团队聊天系统，支持公开/私有群组、私信与实时消息通信。特色功能为 Telegram 双向消息桥接，Bot 驱动跨平台无缝同步。前端采用 Vue 3 + Hono，Durable Objects 承载 WebSocket 连接，AES-256-GCM 加密保障数据安全，在免费额度内即可落地企业级 IM。
repos.summary_en: EdgeChat is a zero-infrastructure team chat system built on Cloudflare ecosystem, supporting public/private groups, DMs, and real-time messaging. Its standout feature is bidirectional Telegram bridge via Bot for seamless cross-platform sync. Powered by Vue 3 + Hono frontend, Durable Objects for WebSocket, and AES-256-GCM encryption, it delivers enterprise-grade IM within Cloudflare's free tier.

repos.description: 这是一个基于AI的自动化交易程序，专为数字货币市场（BNB/USDT）设计。该程序旨在实现全自动化交易，通过AI算法帮助用户在数字货币市场中做出更智能的交易决策。
repos.summary_zh: GridBNB 是一个基于 Python 的企业级自动化交易程序，专为币安交易所设计，支持多币种并发网格交易。通过动态波动率分析、EWMA 混合算法和多层风险管理，实现稳定捕捉市场波动收益。提供 Docker 容器化部署、Nginx 反向代理、实时监控 Web 界面及理财功能集成，适合专业交易者进行自动化数字货币交易。
repos.summary_en: GridBNB is a Python-based enterprise-grade automated trading program designed for Binance exchange, supporting concurrent grid trading across multiple cryptocurrency pairs. It leverages dynamic volatility analysis, EWMA hybrid algorithms, and multi-layer risk management to capture market fluctuations profitably. Features include Docker deployment, Nginx proxy, real-time monitoring web UI, and integrated savings functionality for professional crypto trading automation.

repos.description: A full-stack, edge-native SaaS starter built with TanStack Start + Cloudflare Workers  | 基于 TanStack Start + Cloudflare Workers 构建的全栈、边缘原生 SaaS 起步模板
repos.summary_zh: FlareStarter 是一款基于 TanStack Start 与 Cloudflare Workers 构建的全栈、边缘原生 SaaS 起步模板。它集成了鉴权、Stripe 计费、邮件、i18n 及运营后台等核心模块，利用 Cloudflare 全球边缘网络实现毫秒级响应与极低成本。项目强调端到端类型安全，提供开箱即用的生产级代码，支持 fork 即用，旨在帮助开发者快速部署具备商业闭环能力的现代 Web 应用。
repos.summary_en: FlareStarter is a full-stack, edge-native SaaS starter built with TanStack Start and Cloudflare Workers. It integrates essential modules like authentication, Stripe billing, email, i18n, and an admin dashboard. Leveraging Cloudflare's global edge network, it delivers millisecond latency and near-zero operational costs. Featuring end-to-end type safety and production-ready code, it enables developers to quickly deploy modern web applications with complete commercial capabilities.

repos.description: 月饼TV
repos.summary_zh: MoonCakeTV 是一个基于 Next.js 15 和 TypeScript 的影视聚合搜索服务，支持多源聚合搜索（苹果CMS v10协议）、HLS.js 在线播放、收藏与历史记录、响应式深色主题及可选密码保护，数据持久化存储无需数据库，支持一键 Docker 部署与 HTTPS 自动配置。
repos.summary_en: MoonCakeTV is a simple yet powerful video aggregation and search service built with Next.js 15 and TypeScript. It supports multi-source search via AppleCMS v10 protocol, HLS.js streaming, favorites, watch history, responsive dark mode, optional password protection, and stores data without a database. Features one-click Docker deployment with automatic HTTPS via Caddy.

repos.description: 一个简单的网络分析跟踪器和仪表板，在 Cloudflare Pages 上即可快速部署的网站分析仪表板,无成本稳定运行
repos.summary_zh: Han-Analytics 是一个基于 Cloudflare Pages 的无服务器网站分析工具，提供轻量级网络跟踪与可视化仪表板功能，支持零成本部署、高并发访问（每日10万次免费统计），具备密码保护和网站白名单等安全特性，适用于个人或企业快速集成网站数据分析。
repos.summary_en: Han-Analytics is a serverless web analytics tool built on Cloudflare Pages, offering lightweight tracking and dashboard visualization with zero-cost deployment, high-concurrency support (up to 100k daily free stats), password protection, and website whitelisting for secure data collection and analysis.

repos.description: Cloudflare Worker; Claude Code; Proxy; Easy to deploy; Claude Code Router; claude-code-router; ccr
repos.summary_zh: 该项目是一个基于 Cloudflare Worker 的 Claude Code 代理工具，支持将 Gemini 和 OpenAI 等第三方大模型 API 转换为 Claude 格式，实现零配置快速部署。核心特性包括流式响应、工具调用支持，并可通过 One-Balance 实现低成本 Claude Code 使用。
repos.summary_en: This project is a Cloudflare Worker-based proxy that converts third-party LLM APIs (Gemini, OpenAI) into Claude-compatible format, enabling zero-config deployment. It supports streaming/non-streaming responses, tool calls, and integrates with One-Balance for cost-effective Claude Code usage.

repos.summary_zh: EdgeMirror 是一款基于 Cloudflare Workers 和 Vercel Functions 构建的 CDN 式边缘镜像网关。它通过单一域名路径路由，为 PyPI、PyTorch、Hugging Face、GitHub、Docker 及 Linux 镜像等主流开发者资源提供统一的加速代理，有效解决网络访问受限或速度慢的问题。
repos.summary_en: EdgeMirror is a CDN-style edge mirror gateway built on Cloudflare Workers and Vercel Functions. It provides unified acceleration for major developer resources like PyPI, PyTorch, Hugging Face, GitHub, Docker, and Linux mirrors via single-domain path routing, solving network access and speed issues.

repos.description: Public docs & issues for flow.ci
repos.summary_zh: flow.ci 是一个开源的持续集成与部署平台，提供中英文双语文档和公开的问题追踪系统，旨在帮助开发者高效管理 CI/CD 流程，支持自动化构建、测试与部署。
repos.summary_en: flow.ci is an open-source continuous integration and deployment platform offering bilingual documentation (English and Chinese) and a public issue tracker to help developers streamline CI/CD workflows with automation.

repos.description: Self-hosted short link and live QR platform with ownership, review, branded QR codes, analytics, and an auditable path to AI-assisted operations.
repos.summary_zh: AI Shortlink 是一个自托管的短链与活码管理平台，强调链接传播后的可控性。核心功能包括短链管理、多策略活码运营、品牌二维码生成及团队协作审核。采用 Go 单体架构与 SQLite 部署，支持 Docker 一键启动，并规划了基于大模型的 AI 辅助运营演进路线。
repos.summary_en: AI Shortlink is a self-hosted short link and live QR platform emphasizing post-distribution control. It offers short link management, multi-strategy live QR operations, branded QR code generation, and team collaboration with audits. Built as a monolithic Go service with SQLite, it supports Docker deployment and outlines a roadmap for AI-assisted operations.

repos.description: 开源AI生图工具，免登录畅玩 FLUX2、SDXL，支持 cloudflare workers 一键部署自托管，并集成各大主流AI提供商，提供一站式的创作体验。
repos.summary_zh: Typix 是一款开源 AI 生图工具，支持免登录使用 FLUX2、SDXL 等主流模型，提供 Cloudflare Workers 一键自托管部署，集成 Google、OpenAI、Fal 等多平台 AI 服务，兼具浏览器本地存储与可选云同步，保障用户数据隐私与创作自由。
repos.summary_en: Typix is an open-source AI image generation tool that enables login-free access to FLUX2, SDXL, and other models. It offers one-click self-hosting via Cloudflare Workers, integrates multiple AI providers like Google and OpenAI, and supports local browser storage with optional cloud sync for privacy and seamless cross-device creativity.

repos.description: 一个监控股票的工具
repos.summary_zh: iNeedMyMoneyBack 是一款面向个人投资者的桌面端股票监控工具，支持 A 股、港股、美股及指数的实时行情展示。用户可自定义监控列表、显示字段与刷新频率，并在价格达到目标值时接收系统通知。界面支持表格与滚动模式、全局快捷键、双击跳转行情网站，并内置自动更新组件，适合需要持续关注持仓与大盘动态的股民使用。
repos.summary_en: iNeedMyMoneyBack is a desktop stock monitoring tool for individual investors, providing real-time quotes for A-shares, HK, US stocks, and major indices. Users can customize watchlists, display fields, and refresh intervals, and receive system notifications when target prices are reached. The app supports table and scroll views, global shortcuts, double-click navigation to financial sites, and includes an auto-update component, making it ideal for tracking portfolios and market movements.

repos.description: QuickShare on Cloudflare Workers with R2, D1 and per-user content management
repos.summary_zh: QuickShare Cloudflare 是一个基于 Cloudflare Workers、R2 和 D1 构建的轻量级内容分享工具，专为 AI 生成的 HTML、Markdown、SVG 和 Mermaid 内容设计。用户粘贴内容即可生成可分享链接，无需注册或登录，支持可选的 5 位数字密码保护。内容正文存储在 R2，元数据管理在 D1，实现高效分离。每个浏览器自动获得 owner cookie，支持个人后台管理、编辑和删除内容。一键部署到 Cloudflare，完全掌控数据与部署。
repos.summary_en: QuickShare Cloudflare is a lightweight content-sharing tool built on Cloudflare Workers, R2, and D1, designed for AI-generated HTML, Markdown, SVG, and Mermaid content. Users paste content to generate shareable links instantly—no sign-up required—with optional 5-digit password protection. Content bodies are stored in R2, while metadata is managed in D1 for efficient separation. Each browser gets an owner cookie for personal admin control. Fully deployable to Cloudflare with one click, giving you full ownership of data and deployment.

repos.summary_zh: 本项目演示如何使用 Docker Compose 快速搭建基于 Docker 的 Django 应用开发环境，包含 Django、MySQL 和 Redis 服务编排，支持一键构建与部署，适用于容器化 Django 项目的开发与测试。
repos.summary_en: This project demonstrates how to quickly set up a Django development environment using Docker Compose, including orchestration of Django, MySQL, and Redis services. It supports one-click build and deployment, ideal for containerized Django development and testing.
